const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime

root = Path.cwd()
baseline = 'c47286947351bd290128ba59f8b1c7c278df54b2'
files = ['engine.lua','mod-tome.lua','tome-ashes-urhrok.lua','tome-cults.lua','tome-orcs.lua']
ids = {
'01aa8dc56eaa88c617b68ad2b292caa510e9e0169e86843699eb258fdff9b738',
'2df8a382c9444ee30e8243d237473584971b63222a990578ff55b943e456fe2b',
'3358ca54b7e2473348e93f516c8c1c759dd06eb9c1fbf3915d33f5b92dd32980',
'5b02c215259ab029994e045091a08a3184d50134f165878cfa33c2ef75e2fc27',
'81725ede54a43c363a80f328646f9f9e90abb8462acb0a774290c4e49f0fbfc3',
'9785f1fb51e01839e972ab50ae5b1d2ad4b14187e83842a685531d793c67213f',
'eac1a2f40ecef55b2cc7c610001f4d535e0f5913286311fbaed3048ef264b719',
'd6caf43dd1b521ff4dd5ad1ef14370a85566cb34f2a5b142ede78eb11a678026'}
workset = json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w57-20260930/WORKSET.json').read_text())['items']
adj = json.loads((root/'.ai/task/repair-w57-20260930/ADJUDICATION-F2.json').read_text())
confirmed = {f['revision_key']: f['replacements'] for f in adj['findings'] if f['status']=='confirmed'}
assert set(confirmed) == ids
manifest = load_manifest()
loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
current_docs = {}
baseline_docs = {}
for file in files:
    current_docs[file] = loader.load_path(root/file, logical_path=file)
    raw = subprocess.run(['git','show',f'{baseline}:{file}'],check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout
    baseline_docs[file] = loader.load_bytes(raw, logical_path=file)
    assert len(current_docs[file].records) == len(baseline_docs[file].records), file
expected = set()
index_for_id = {}
for item in workset:
    file = item['normalized_path']
    matches=[]
    for i, rec in enumerate(baseline_docs[file].records):
        if (rec.get('kind')=='translation' and rec.get('section','')==item['section'] and
            rec.get('source')==item['source'] and (rec.get('source_tag') or '')==(item.get('source_tag') or '') and
            rec.get('target')==item['target_preimage']):
            matches.append(i)
    assert len(matches)==1, (item['entry_revision_identity'], len(matches))
    idx=matches[0]
    expected.add((file,idx))
    index_for_id[item['entry_revision_identity']] = (file,idx)
assert len(expected)==87
changed=set(); counts={}
for file in files:
    count=0
    for i,(base,cur) in enumerate(zip(baseline_docs[file].records,current_docs[file].records)):
        b={k:v for k,v in base.items() if k!='logical_path'}
        c={k:v for k,v in cur.items() if k!='logical_path'}
        if b!=c:
            bd=dict(b); cd=dict(c); bt=bd.pop('target',None); ct=cd.pop('target',None)
            assert bd==cd and bt!=ct, (file,i)
            changed.add((file,i)); count+=1
    counts[file]=count
assert changed==expected, (len(changed),len(expected),changed^expected)
print('BASELINE_SCOPE_PASS', len(changed), counts)
for key in sorted(ids):
    file,idx=index_for_id[key]
    target=current_docs[file].records[idx]['target']
    result=target
    for n,repl in enumerate(confirmed[key],1):
        occurrences=result.count(repl['old'])
        assert occurrences==1,(key,n,occurrences)
        result=result.replace(repl['old'],repl['new'],1)
    print(key[:10], file, 'replacements', len(confirmed[key]), 'current_chars', len(target), 'expected_chars', len(result))
print('REPLACEMENT_PRECONDITIONS_PASS')
PY","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
